content.text: Everything you need to share the launch this weekend is right here 💗 Copy it, tweak a word or two so it sounds like you, and post.

Step 1: Get your affiliate link
Heads up: your Skool settings do not have this link. Skool's affiliate link is for the community, not for this product. Your link comes from Beacons.
• Sign in to your own Beacons account at beacons.ai. If you don't have one, make a free account first.
• In your Beacons store, add a new product and choose the option to sell someone else's product as an affiliate.
• When it asks for the product, paste this link: https://links.thedigitalincomeedit.com/shop/66271fb0-fc54-4aae-ad9f-c826f4635ee7
• Beacons adds The While-You-Sleep Storefront™ to your own store and gives you your own tracked link. That link is the one you share everywhere below.
• Open your link in a private window to check it shows the product at $27.
The one line that goes on everything
Every single post, story, email and pin needs a disclosure. Use this, or your own version of it: #ad · affiliate link, I earn a commission at no extra cost to you.
No promises about money anywhere. You're sharing a tool, not a result 🙌
